name: fyi
description: Read-only FYI (FYI Docs) practice data on your dashboard: open jobs by state, recent jobs, tasks due soon, recently filed documents, outstanding invoices, chargeable time and manager workload.

connection.instructions: In FYI, an FYI Admin opens **Automation → Apps**, then the app tile's cog → **Create new secret** (or the **Custom Applications** tile, if FYI has unlocked it for your practice). Copy the **Access Key ID** and **Access Key Secret** — the secret is shown only once. Needs FYI Pro or Elite; invoice tiles need Elite.

fields.name: FYI_ACCESS_ID
fields.label: Access Key ID
fields.helpText: From FYI → Automation → Apps → Create new secret.

fields.name: FYI_ACCESS_SECRET
fields.label: Access Key Secret
fields.helpText: Shown once when the key is created. Regenerating it invalidates the old one.

fields.name: FYI_REGION
fields.label: Region
fields.helpText: au (Australia and New Zealand, the default) or uk.

fields.name: FYI_APPLICATION_ID
fields.label: Application ID (optional)
fields.helpText: Only if FYI issued an Application ID for a partner app. Leave blank for practice-generated keys.
